modeReason: The top story — a regulator investigating AI companies' safety practices around the same time as their voluntary self-policing pledge, plus one of those companies separately letting go of three safety researchers — scores 3×3×2=18, well above the fresh threshold of 8.
phrase: The AI companies promised to police themselves on safety. Around the same time, regulators opened an investigation, and in an unrelated move, one company let go of three safety researchers.
phraseAlternatives: A regulator began investigating AI companies around the same time they promised to police themselves.
One company quietly let go of three safety researchers, in a move it says was unrelated to any outside investigation.
AI companies said they would police themselves. Regulators, watching closely, decided to check anyway.
The self-policing pledge and the regulatory investigation are happening at the same time. That alone says something.

brief.concept: A robot proudly wears a badge that says it polices itself, while a government building holds a magnifying glass up to inspect it; in an unrelated corner of the scene, a smaller robot quietly walks out the door with a box.
brief.metaphor: Self-regulation is a badge that someone else decides to inspect, while separate, unrelated housekeeping happens off to the side.
cast: a robot wearing a chest badge labeled SELF POLICE
a government building icon holding a large magnifying glass
a small robot walking away carrying a box
brief.composition: Center-left: a robot stands with chest out, wearing a round badge reading 'SELF POLICE'. Upper right: a small government-building icon holds a large magnifying glass angled down at the badge. Lower right corner, clearly separate and smaller scale: a second robot walks off-panel carrying a cardboard box, a small 'EXIT' label above it. Flat riso shapes in blue and fluorescent pink, thick outlines, cream paper texture.
brief.alt: A robot wears a badge reading 'self police' while a government building holds a large magnifying glass over it; in a separate corner, a smaller robot walks away carrying a box under an exit sign.
